_comment: Maps control/TRS file index to monster identity when Monster Data # sprite number disagrees with extracted art, or when multiple monsters share one sprite number.

1018.visual_subject: elderly bearded storm giant in purple toga, holding lightning bolts
1018.note: Control art is Storm Titan (storm giant king with lightning). Monster Data assigns sprite 1018 to Knight, Crusader, and Phantasmal Knight; Storm Titan is listed as sprite 11072.
